name: Kai Murukku
steps: Dry-roast urad dal until aromatic but still pale; cool, grind very fine and sieve to remove coarse bits.
Combine rice flour, urad flour, sesame, salt and asafoetida; rub in the measured vegetable oil until crumbly.
Add water gradually to make a soft, nonsticky dough; cover with a damp cloth so the surface does not dry.
Roll a small portion into a slender rope, twist it gently and wind it into a loose open spiral on a greased sheet.
Slide each hand-twisted spiral into medium-hot oil and fry until bubbling stops and both sides are pale golden; cool fully before storing.
tips: Kai means hand: twisting the rope by hand gives this murukku its open braided spiral.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
